overview: The Medford School Committee announced the approval of new contracts for nurses, carpenters, and administrative assistants, and approved Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent's goals for the 2022–2023 school year. The committee also approved a student trip to France, received reports on mentoring and after-school programming, and voted on proposed state school committee resolutions.

items.title: Executive Session and Union Contract Approvals
items.summary: The committee convened in executive session and later announced the unanimous approval of new collective bargaining agreements for school nurses, carpenters, and administrative assistants.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Minutes Amendment
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda after amending the June 29 Committee of the Whole minutes to clarify Member Ruseau's absence due to lack of notice.

items.title: Field Trip Request to France
items.summary: The committee approved an April 2023 high school world language trip to France, contingent on a legal review of the trip cancellation insurance policy regarding COVID-19 coverage.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent provided updates on school open houses, community events, athletic schedules, and district initiatives.

items.title: Superintendent's Goals for 2022–2023
items.summary: The committee approved the Superintendent's district improvement, student learning, and professional practice goals for the 2022–2023 school year as amended.

items.title: Report on Educator Induction and Mentoring
items.summary: Staff presented an overview of the new educator induction and mentoring program and outlined plans to expand mentoring support for administrators.

items.title: Public Presentation on After-School Programming
items.summary: A resident presented concerns regarding waitlists and capacity for elementary after-school programs, and administration outlined ongoing staffing and space constraints.

items.title: Policy Rescissions Second Reading
items.summary: The committee voted to rescind a series of administrative and operational policies that are already covered by state law.

items.title: MASC Resolutions Guidance Votes
items.summary: The committee voted to instruct its delegate on six resolutions proposed for the upcoming Massachusetts Association of School Committees delegate assembly.
